sources.facts: City locates the standing stone lighthouse just north of Gibraltar Point Beach.
Hexagonal Queenston-stone construction, walls six feet thick at base and four at top. In 1832 masonry raised to 64 feet. Height through historic vane was 82 feet.

ASI marine archaeology assessment for Toronto conservation authority, section on Gibraltar Point and transcription of the Lake Light plaque, documenting the 1808 hexagonal tower and later raise to 82 feet.
